measurement_intent: L2 cache bandwidth work-amount sweep with a fixed L2-resident working set

scaling_parameter.name: num_elements
scaling_parameter.description: Selected comparison problem_size axis: output elements/threads. Work scales with this axis while working_set_size stays fixed. Total read bytes for a run are num_elements * num_iterations * bytes_per_read.

work_model.description: Default HIP/CUDA measured work for the L2 cache-bandwidth probe. The cache-residency footprint is controlled by non-scaling working_set_size. Go simulator rows use num_repeats for the same repeat-count role.

working_set_size.description: Fixed L2-resident input footprint in bytes

block_size.description: Thread block size for kernel launches

num_iterations.description: HIP/CUDA name for repeated read iterations per output element; Go simulator flag is num_repeats

stride.description: Stride between consecutive memory accesses (in elements)
